title: November 2 XRP derivatives snapshot and cbXRP collateral source-freshness audit

tradradar.methodology: Seven exchange perpetual futures aggregation; 15-minute delay; liquidation totals are lower bounds because exchange disclosures are incomplete.

kodexius.methodology: Seven listed contracts across five venues; USDT and USDC contracts are separately enumerated.

spot_and_derivatives.comparability: Do not average the $1.93B TradRadar total and $765.03M Kodexius total. The provider universes differ by exchanges, contract count, contract currency and coverage. The difference is not evidence of a market data error by itself.

cbxrp_proof_of_reserves.statement: Coinbase describes cbXRP as a wrapped token backed 1:1 by XRP held by Coinbase.
cbxrp_proof_of_reserves.interpretation: The previously recorded 150.94M supply/reserve figures are historical observations from a page whose displayed refresh time is September 7. Do not treat them as November 2 balances or current proof of reserves.

morphowatch_cbxrp_usdc.conflict: The prior research handoff recorded a later MorphoWatch observation at 2026-11-01T22:11Z with approximately $65.8M supplied, $59.3M borrowed, 90.1% utilization and 118.77M cbXRP collateral. The currently retrievable page reports an earlier update time (2026-10-31T06:51Z) and slightly different values. These are retained as separate observations; no direct Morpho API response was captured in this run.

feature_admission.permitted: Timestamped derivatives observations may enter the feature store with provider universe/methodology metadata and explicit staleness.
feature_admission.blocked: Do not admit Coinbase cbXRP reserve figures as current; do not treat Morpho collateral/utilization values as current until a fresh raw Morpho API snapshot is captured and reconciled.

interpretations: TradRadar shows open interest rising 1.98% over 24 hours while funding remains positive and 75.5% of tracked accounts are long. This indicates a crowded-long risk condition in that provider's universe, not a directional price forecast.
Liquidations are reported as a lower bound; missing exchange liquidation disclosures make the true total uncertain.

The cbXRP/USDC market provides a concrete XRP-collateral-to-USDC-credit pathway, but the currently retrievable reserve and Morpho pages are too stale or conflicting for live collateral-flow conclusions.
next_actions: Capture Morpho's raw market API response and pin block number, timestamp, market ID, supplied/borrowed amounts, collateral amount, oracle and liquidation events.
Capture Coinbase cbXRP proof-of-reserves page refresh metadata and reserve values again when Coinbase publishes a newer observation.
Normalize exchange-level OI by contract ID, quote asset, venue, open/close methodology and timestamp.
Add long/short account share, funding dispersion, liquidation asymmetry and OI/volume to shadow features only after historical coverage and provider methodology are stable.
Keep the Binance attacker-wallet event separate from aggregate exchange-wallet flows and actual sale estimates.
